name: privacypage-mcp
description: Generate privacy policies, ToS, EULAs, cookie policies & disclaimers from your AI agent.
long_description: MCP server for PrivacyPage (privacypage.io). Generates privacy policies, terms of service, EULAs, cookie policies, and liability disclaimers for the app you're building, straight from your AI agent. Every generate tool returns a free 25-line preview plus a documentId; the full document is unlocked with a one-time license (no subscription).

tools.name: generate_privacy_policy
tools.description: Generate a GDPR/CCPA/COPPA-aware privacy policy for an app or website

appName.description: Name of the app or website, e.g. 'MyApp'

companyName.description: Company or developer name, e.g. 'Acme Inc.'

dataCollected.description: Types of data the app collects, e.g. 'Name & Email', 'Location Data', 'Usage Analytics'

thirdPartyServices.description: Third-party services/SDKs the app uses, e.g. 'Google Analytics / Firebase', 'Stripe / Payments'

childrenUnder13.description: Whether the app is directed at children under 13 (COPPA)

tools.name: generate_terms_of_service
tools.description: Generate a Terms of Service agreement for an app or service

serviceName.description: Name of the app or service

keyPolicies.description: Key policies that apply, e.g. 'No refunds', 'User-generated content'

tools.name: generate_eula
tools.description: Generate an End-User License Agreement for a software application

restrictions.description: Usage restrictions, e.g. 'No reverse engineering', 'No redistribution'

tools.name: generate_cookie_policy
tools.description: Generate a GDPR-aware cookie policy for a website or web app

websiteName.description: Name of the website or app

cookieTypes.description: Cookie categories the site uses, e.g. 'Essential cookies', 'Analytics cookies'

thirdPartyServices.description: Third-party services that set cookies, e.g. 'Google Analytics', 'Facebook Pixel'

tools.name: generate_disclaimer
tools.description: Generate a liability disclaimer (general, medical, financial, fitness, legal, or affiliate)

websiteName.description: Name of the website or app

companyName.description: Company name, if different from the site name

disclaimerType.description: The type of disclaimer that matches the site's content

externalLinks.description: Whether the site links to external websites

tools.name: get_full_document
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a previously generated document using a PrivacyPage license key

documentId.description: The documentId returned by a generate_* tool

licenseKey.description: PrivacyPage license key. Falls back to the PRIVACYPAGE_LICENSE_KEY environment variable.

privacypage_license_key.title: PrivacyPage License Key
privacypage_license_key.description: Optional. One-time license key from privacypage.io ($9.99 single document / $24.99 bundle) used by get_full_document to unlock full documents. Free previews work without it.
